annotations.title: Math text to Nemeth braille (linear expressions)

description:
Converts a linear math expression (e.g. x^2+1=5) to Nemeth-code braille cells. Note the surrounding engine is pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code. Best for linear expressions; complex 2D layouts need reviewer post-processing.
한국어: 한 줄 수식을 네메스 점자로 변환합니다.
name: braille_math_nemeth
